question: Owner 2026-11-08: can the 25-coin alarm-entry rule be improved by confirming the 1.618 reclaim on a shorter candle (5 or 15 minutes instead of 60), cutting failed rebounds earlier?
approval: Owner 2026-11-08 '你能基于这些研究 再找找还有没有更好的方案吗 做成策略'; split per owner '2020 2024年的币种很少 为啥不用2025年的'
single_variable: Reclaim confirmation length (touch-timeframe candle and its successor must close before protection): 5, 15, or the frozen 60 minutes. Everything else is the alarm study's 30-minute near30 hold plan.
decision_rule: Select on 2020-2025 together: among 5 and 15, the one with the higher frac N20 3x multiple over 2020-2025 (one replay from 2020 through 2025), and only if it beats 60 over the same span. Adopt only if it also beats 60 in 2026 on both the frac multiple and the per-trade mean. Otherwise keep 60. Paired episode-level differences are reported for 2020-24, 2025 and 2026.
sizing: monday_limit_return_opt.frac N20 3x through monday_limit_paper_accounts.replay, by period
fees: Codex config maker 0.02 / taker 0.05 percent (OKX Lv1, read 2026-10-23); 10bp slippage on non-target exits; worse intrabar path; funding not modelled
control: Paired: the 60-minute exit on the same fills (entries unchanged, so the alarm study's random-time entry control still applies to entries)
in_sample: All periods were seen before; 2026 is a held-back check only for the choice between 5 and 15, not a blind test. Fills end with the frozen ledger (touches to 2026-09-30).
split_note: Owner correction 2026-11-08 '我没说用2025年这一年的呀 用2020-2025这5年的': selection span is 2020-2025, test 2026. Amended before any full-run result was read; the first registration (select on 2025 alone) is superseded.
